conditional_math_bound.assumption: Identical resampled positive normalized P and cosine-minus-one kernel; only epsilon=.01 exponential versus linear map differs, no other regridding/bandwidth changes
conditional_math_bound.derivation: For g(s)=(exp(b*s)-1)/expm1(b), interpolation error <=max|gsecond|/8=b^2*exp(b)/(8*expm1(b)), b<=.02. Affine fit can do no worse than secant.
conditional_math_bound.consequence: Under these assumptions exponentiation alone cannot explain >1.1percent normalizedRMS. Does not identify truehistoricalkernel/processingpath.
